anomalies.observed: S2 connects NET0001 to GND when pressed. On the SkylabModule sheet, NET0001 is connected to U11.47 (I2C_SD); U11.45 (HW_RESET) is on a different net, NET0011.
anomalies.expected: The reset switch should connect HW_RESET to GND, as specified.

evidence.quote: S2 pin 1 → NET0001; pin 2 → GND; U11 pin 47 → NET0001 and pin 45 → NET0011 (HW_RESET) (EthernetAndPower, page 4; SkylabModule, page 2)

anomalies.impact: Pressing the switch will pull I2C_SD low instead of asserting hardware reset, so the intended reset control will not work and the I2C signal may be disrupted.

parsed.summary: The reset switch is wired to NET0001, which reaches the module's I2C_SD pin, rather than to HW_RESET. This conflicts with the specified reset-switch connection.
